description_en: Queries the details of screen recording files
description_zh: 查询录屏文件的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun ecd describe-recordings --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --max-results 20 --next-token aGN4YzAxQGNuLWhhbmd6aG91LjExNzU5NTMyNjgzMTQ10000 --policy-group-id pg-gx2x1dhsmthe90000 --desktop-id ecd-hlh41mk78dugw0000 --start-time 20230424000000 --end-time 20230424004441 --need-signed-url false --signed-url-expire-minutes 10 --standard-start-time 2025-01-27T02:20:10Z --standard-end-time 2025-01-27T02:30:10Z --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeRecordings

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) operation to query the list of regions where Elastic Desktop Service (EDS) Enterprise is available
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries per page.

Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页行数。

最大值：100。

默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of `NextToken`
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token）。取值为上一次调用该接口返回的`NextToken`参数值，初次调用接口时无需设置该参数
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The cloud computer ID. If this parameter is not specified, the screen recording files on all cloud computers in the designated region will be queried
parameters.help_zh: 云电脑ID。不指定时，表示查询该地域下所有云电脑
parameters.name: desktop_id

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. Specify the time in the `YYYYMMDDhhmmss` format. The time must be in UTC+8
parameters.help_zh: 查询的开始时间。使用UTC+8时间，格式为`YYYYMMDDhhmmss`
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. Specify the time in the `YYYYMMDDhhmmss` format. The time must be in UTC+8
parameters.help_zh: 查询的结束时间。使用UTC+8时间，格式为`YYYYMMDDhhmmss`
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return a URL.

Valid values:

true
false (default)
parameters.name: need_signed_url

parameters.help_en: The validity period of the returned URL. Unit: minutes
parameters.help_zh: 返回URL的有效时间。单位：分钟
parameters.name: signed_url_expire_minutes

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the `yyyy-mm-ddthh:mm:ssz` format. The time must be in UTC+0
parameters.help_zh: 查询的开始时间。按照ISO 8601标准表示，并使用 UTC+0 时间，格式为`yyyy-mm-ddthh:mm:ssz`
parameters.name: standard_start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the `yyyy-mm-ddthh:mm:ssz` format. The time must be in UTC+0
parameters.help_zh: 查询的结束时间。按照ISO 8601标准表示，并使用 UTC+0 时间，格式为`yyyy-mm-ddthh:mm:ssz`
parameters.name: standard_end_time
